To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the first principles study of transition metal (Nb, Ti, Mo and W) carbides compounds associated to the Nb–C,Ti–C,Mo-CandW–Calloy systems, using the density functional theory (DFT), is in excellent agreement with the experimental findings.

the ground state properties of the transition metal carbides are in good agreement with experimental and theoretical data, and that the lattice dynamics properties are in agreement with experimental and other theoretical findings.

the ground-state and elastic properties of the Nb–C and Mo–C compounds are well described by the generalized gradient approximation, while the Ti–C and W–C compounds are better described by the local density approximation.
